canonicalRoot(bytes32).notice: Compute the canonical SHA-256 domain-separated commitment to the         verifier entries under a given registry root.

canonicalRootMatches(bytes32).notice: Check whether the committed registry root matches the canonical         root computed from actual entries.

computeCanonicalRoot(bytes32[],address[].notice: Compute the canonical SHA-256 domain-separated commitment to the         verifier entries under a given registry root. Encoding (must match Clojure canonical-verifier-registry.root):   entry_hash_i = SHA256(     verifierId      (32 bytes)     || adapter      (32 bytes, address as uint256 big-endian)     || programVKey  (32 bytes)     || elfSha256    (32 bytes)     || programIdHash (32 bytes, SHA256 of UTF-8 programId)     || schemaHash   (32 bytes)     || active       (32 bytes, 0x00..01 or 0x00..00)   )   registryRoot = SHA256(     "PRF_VERIFIER_REGISTRY_V1" (25 bytes UTF-8)     || uint256(entry_count) (32 bytes, big-endian)     || sorted_by_verifierId(entry_hash_0, ..., entry_hash_{n-1})   )Compute the canonical registry root from a list of verifier entries.         This is a pure function usable before entries are stored on-chain,         so callers can compute the root and use it as the registryRoot         parameter when calling registerVerifier.         Parameters are parallel arrays of equal length. Entries are         automatically sorted by verifierId before hashing.         Encoding (must match Clojure canonical-verifier-registry.root):   entry_hash_i = SHA256(     verifierId          (32 bytes)     || adapter          (20 bytes, address)     || programVKey      (32 bytes)     || elfSha256        (32 bytes)     || programIdHash     (32 bytes, SHA256 of UTF-8 programId)     || schemaHash        (32 bytes, statement schema version hash)     || publicValuesSchema (32 bytes, public-values schema hash)     || active            (32 bytes, 0x00..01 or 0x00..00)   )   registryRoot = SHA256(     "PRF_VERIFIER_REGISTRY_V1" (25 bytes UTF-8)     || uint256(entry_count) (32 bytes, big-endian)     || sorted_by_verifierId(entry_hash_0, ..., entry_hash_{n-1})   )
